posts.name: Rankhog
posts.tagline: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot
posts.description: Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.

posts.name: Yoroll
posts.tagline: Build playable stories without a game engine
posts.description: Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game.

posts.name: Resurf
posts.tagline: Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac
posts.description: A fully local personal context library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Save notes, links, images, and documents. Hand off context to AI through MCP or the CLI on Mac.

posts.name: Daymaker
posts.tagline: Gifts so personal, your prospects take the meeting.
posts.description: Daymaker is known for coldcakes, that ends today. Daymaker is the tool that researches your prospects, finds out their interests, recommends a personalized gift, repackages it in your branding, and sends it to your prospect. Making sure you get your meeting. Want it done for you? We run the campaign and guarantee the meetings.

posts.name: oovi
posts.tagline: Your own team of AI on your desktop
posts.description: Hand oovi a job and a team of AI bots does it: a leader plans, a researcher digs, a writer drafts, a critic checks. Watch each bot work, and approve anything before it goes out. Free with your own AI key, or from $10/mo with credits that never expire.

posts.name: Omi CLI
posts.tagline: An AI coding agent in your terminal, on 13 models
posts.description: Omi can build anything, now from your terminal. Omi CLI reads your repo, shows every edit as a diff you approve, and runs tests until they pass. New in 0.5.0: parallel subagents, browser testing, background and cloud agents. Free: npm i -g @builditomi/cli

posts.name: Webless Agents
posts.tagline: Agents you want to put in front of customers
posts.description: You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.

posts.name: Creavit Studio 4.0
posts.tagline: Screen recording, iPhone camera and cinematic demos for Mac
posts.description: Plan, record and turn your screen into a product story. Creavit Studio 4.0 brings QR-paired iPhone portrait capture, camera takes added after recording, Content Planner, Standard and Liquid MultiFocus, cinematic 3D MacBook and iPhone scenes, Smooth Scroll, Smooth Typing, your voice in another language, and Auto FX with your approval at every stage. Built for Mac. Also available on iPhone for recording and editing on the go.

posts.name: Ulika
posts.tagline: Visual editor for sites built with Claude, Cursor, or Codex
posts.description: AI can ship a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend. Then marketing wants a headline change and opens a ticket. Ulika connects the site so anyone can edit copy and images on the page and publish, without touching code. Open beta, free to try at ulika.co.

posts.name: Mockreel
posts.tagline: your screen recording, but in a 3D phone. free, no signup
posts.description: ok so every time I launch an app I need one of those 3D phone videos, and every tool wants a download or a subscription. nope. built my own. you drop in a screen recording (or a screenshot, I don't judge), it shows up inside a 3D iPhone / MacBook / iPad / browser window, you pick a look, add a camera move, slap a headline on it, export MP4 up to 4K. runs in a browser tab. no upload, no signup, no watermark, no catch. it's free. go make your app look expensive.

posts.name: Copy Haste
posts.tagline: Your clipboard, sorted into Text, Code, Links, Media & more
posts.description: Most clipboard managers give you one long list. Copy Haste sorts everything you copy into Text, Code, Links, Files, Media and Colors columns, so you find things by type instead of scrolling. Code is highlighted with on-device language detection, colors detect 20+ formats, links lose their trackers and passwords stay out. Files and Media are separated. Pin what you reuse and sync pins and settings across your Macs. Your history never leaves your Mac, and there is no account to create. macOS 26.

posts.name: Wispim
posts.tagline: The teleprompter that follows your voice
posts.description: Wispim listens and follows the words you actually say. Pause, and it waits. Speed up, and it keeps up. The script floats over Instagram, TikTok or your camera while you record. iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows, and free in your browser.

posts.name: Slotify
posts.tagline: Schedule game nights without leaving Discord
posts.description: Slotify is a scheduling bot for Discord. Run /slotify, everyone marks when they're free from a personal link, and the best times show up live in your channel. Repeat polls weekly, remind who hasn't answered, and turn the winning time into a Discord event.

posts.name: Pushback
posts.tagline: The flight tracker that knows which lounge you can use
posts.description: A flight tracker for iPhone and Android that knows the lounge your status and cards get you into, whether you’ll make your connection, and your seat in 3D. One board for every flight, and what you may be owed when it’s late. Free while we launch.

posts.name: Do It For Them Wallpaper Maker
posts.tagline: Photo wallpapers for the people you do it for
posts.description: Turn your favorite photos into a taped collage for your phone, desktop, video calls, or social banners. Choose a layout, add your own words, and arrange the photos in your browser. Watermarked downloads are free. $5 buys five watermark-free exports, including ZIPs and 300 DPI print PDFs up to 4 × 6 feet.

posts.name: TeaserKit
posts.tagline: your coding agent directs your launch video
posts.description: TeaserKit is the director for your coding agent's videos. Installed in one line, it makes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents direct a launch video, ad or explainer from your repo or website: a concept, a house style, a human-made song cut to the beat and a quality check before the final render. Includes a local Studio app. One-time purchase.

posts.name: DeNotch
posts.tagline: Hide the MacBook notch and tame your menu bar
posts.description: DeNotch hides the MacBook notch behind a black bar that works on any wallpaper, dynamic and Aerial ones included, and never edits your files. It tidies your menu bar too: hide icons behind ⌄, put them where you want, and show apps only while they matter, like your VPN while it's connected. Beside the notch, a pill holds live widgets (CPU, battery, network, a timer, now playing, GitHub, AI usage limits) and a cat. Free during the beta, for macOS 26 and later.

posts.name: Zapyso
posts.tagline: Free meeting notes and dictation that stay on your Mac
posts.description: Zapyso records your calls on the Mac itself, with no bot joining, and writes a transcript and a summary with decisions and next steps. It notices calls in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Slack and more. Hold the right ⌘ key to dictate into any app. Speech recognition and summaries run on-device, so recordings and notes never leave your Mac. No account. Free, on Mac and iPhone. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 15.

posts.name: Verge: Corner Controls
posts.tagline: Swipe a screen corner to set brightness, volume and more
posts.description: Verge turns the four corners of your Android screen into controls. Swipe in at a corner and a ruler tape wraps around the rounded edge of your display. Slide to set brightness (with extra dim below 0%), volume, launch apps or use quick tools like the flashlight and Do Not Disturb. Free, no ads, no account, no internet permission and no Accessibility Service. The Back gesture stays free, and it speaks 10 languages.

posts.name: 30yr-uptime
posts.tagline: Claude Code mod for taking care of your body
posts.description: A Claude Code mod that turns waiting on Claude into movement breaks. Every 45 min, when a turn runs past 15s, a pixel character acts out one of 16 moves for your neck, back, hips, legs, wrists, eyes or lungs. Done, In 5 min or Skip. Local, zero tokens.

posts.name: Squint
posts.tagline: Explains whatever you're looking at, now on Mac
posts.description: Now on Mac. Press a hotkey, drag a box around anything on your screen, and the answer starts streaming in beside it within moments. No switching apps, no chat window. Also new since the first launch: answers in your own language, one-press copy to hand a capture to your coding agent, and a Microsoft Store install. Windows and Linux too. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Leapdeck
posts.tagline: Leap to any Mac Space from a key or your iPhone
posts.description: Control+arrow walks through every Space between here and there, and each full screen app is a Space of its own. Leapdeck goes straight to the one you want: press a key, click a number in the menu bar, or tap a tile on your iPhone. SIP stays on and there is no account. The Mac app is free, with every hotkey. Leapdeck Pro is one purchase, not a subscription, and adds widgets, Control Center, Siri and Shortcuts on the iPhone, and Space names, a Quick Switcher and more on the Mac.

posts.name: Raccoon Kids
posts.tagline: Gamify Chores for Kids: no more nagging, just a cute raccoon
posts.description: Every family knows the nagging: "Did you make your bed?" every single day. Raccoon Kids takes that over. Reminders go out by themselves, a cute raccoon cheers kids on for every chore, kids show a photo, you approve, and coins become rewards they picked.

posts.name: MeshLive
posts.tagline: Offline video calls and livestreams over Bluetooth mesh
posts.description: MeshLive lets nearby phones make voice/video calls, chat and livestream over a Bluetooth mesh, completely offline. Other phones can relay streams and calls further, extending the range beyond a single Bluetooth connection. Free, open source, and end-to-end encrypted. Available on Android and iPhone, with a Windows and Mac beta too.

posts.name: Perfstaq
posts.tagline: Are you a top 1% developer? Prove it in one command
posts.description: Anyone can claim 5 years of TypeScript. Perfstaq lets you prove it. One command reads your own git history and your Claude Code, Cursor and Codex sessions, on your laptop. Your code never leaves it. Then GitHub spot-checks your commits at random to prove they're really yours. You get your exact standing (Top 1%, 2%, 3%…), cards made to share, and a link any client can verify in 5 seconds. Free, with an open-source scanner.

posts.name: COKIQ
posts.tagline: Cookie consent for Indian websites, with a DPDP Act profile
posts.description: COKIQ is cookie consent for Indian websites. It scans every cookie, tag and pixel your pages load, holds trackers until a visitor chooses, and keeps dated consent records you can export. India DPDP Act banner profile, prices in INR (paid plans from ₹799/month) and a free plan for one site, no card. Passes choices to Google Consent Mode v2. EU/UK and US profiles too. Also: WordPress plugin, Chrome extension, GTM template, iOS/Android app and a public API.

posts.name: Size
posts.tagline: A trading survival game on live market prices
posts.description: Size turns live market prices into competitive cash games. Choose your entry amount, trade through elimination stages, and compete for a cash payout. Try the demo or Practice before entering a cash game. Entry and payout terms apply.

posts.name: MindPal MCP
posts.tagline: ChatGPT & Claude build AI tools your clients use
posts.description: Connect MindPal MCP to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or Cursor and ask in plain words: your assistant builds AI agents and workflows from your knowledge, publishes them as AI tools your clients, team and audience use by link, reads what they asked, and fixes the gaps. Free on every MindPal plan.

posts.name: MediaPostAI
posts.tagline: AI Social Media Post Generator - free captions & hashtags
posts.description: MediaPostAI is an AI social media post generator for every kind of business - from brands and business owners to digital agencies and marketing companies managing many clients. Set up each brand once, and AI creates post ideas, scroll-stopping captions, smart hashtags and on-brand designs. Polish any design in the built-in Canva-like editor, plan posts on your calendar, and connected Facebook Pages publish automatically at the time you choose. Free plan, no credit card needed.

posts.name: Eigen
posts.tagline: AI workspace for teams and their agents
posts.description: Eigen is a secure AI workspace where enterprise teams and their coding agents, like Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, work together in shared rooms with a shared company brain, instead of in separate silos. Teams bring their own model keys and run agents on their own machines, so code and data stay inside their infrastructure, while our proactive agent, Kairo, knows the company inside out and helps take work from issue to shipped.

posts.name: Texter Mess
posts.tagline: A canvas for thinking with LLMs
posts.description: Texter Mess is a canvas for thinking with LLMs. Chats are conversation trees now instead of one linear thread. You can branch every chat in any direction, and everything you connect to a prompt becomes part of its context (even images). You can work on a canvas together with others in real time but if you like working in peace, your changes still sync as soon as you are back. Texter Mess is completely free when using your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

posts.name: RecOmni
posts.tagline: 8K/120fps screen recorder, batch converter & compressor
posts.description: RecOmni is a 3-in-1 offline media studio for Android 11+: Screen Recorder (up to 8K/120fps, facecam, dual audio, 9-zone invisible stop hotspot), Batch Converter (MP4, MOV, audio extraction), and Adaptive Compressor (Bitrate Floor Safeguard, A/B stats comparison). Queue unlimited folders locally with H.264, HEVC, AV1, and APV hardware encoding, no watermarks, no time limits, and no cloud uploads. Free with ads, plus a one-time ad-free Pro upgrade.

posts.name: Wormhole
posts.tagline: One window from your other Mac. No account, no subscription
posts.description: Open just the window you need from your other Mac, as a real window on the Mac you're at: own Dock icon, ⌘Tab, full Retina. Screen Sharing gives you the whole screen in a box. No account, nothing in between. Free for one window at a time; pay once for more.

posts.name: Kaukana
posts.tagline: A daily geography and history game played by train
posts.description: Travel by train between two real cities on a world map. Every stop asks a geography or history question that you answer on the map itself: tap a country that fits a prompt, place an old photo in space and time, order four events, or spot a country by its outline. The rarer your right answer, the farther the train goes. Arrive, and you keep the city's travel poster. Three new journeys a day, the same for everyone. Free, no ads, no account needed.

posts.name: Mishka CMS
posts.tagline: Open-source CMS that runs many websites from one install
posts.description: Mishka CMS runs many websites from one install. Each site gets its own domain, pages and users. Edit pages in a visual editor and changes go live without a redeploy. Bring your WordPress site over with a dry run first. Free and open source (Apache 2.0).

posts.name: Hakanow
posts.tagline: Run hackathons builders love, from sign-up to prizes
posts.description: Hakanow is where builders find hackathons and organizers run them. Hackers discover events, register, form teams and submit. Organizers watch it all live, judges score on a weighted rubric, and every prize is tracked until the winner confirms it.

posts.name: Threddit
posts.tagline: Get customers from Reddit threads that rank on Google
posts.description: A Reddit thread is often the top Google result for what your buyers search, and Google’s AI quotes it too. Threddit finds those threads for your keywords and your competitors’ names, shows monthly searches and Google rank, and scores how well each fits your product. Then it drafts a helpful reply you post yourself: answer the question first, name your product where it genuinely fits. Free to use. Bring your own DataForSEO key (new accounts get free credit). A weekly refresh costs cents.

posts.name: Yachay
posts.tagline: Find the psychologist who fits you
posts.description: Yachay is a matching platform for patients and psychologists. Answer a few questions and find a psychologist suited to your needs.

posts.name: Oyma Beta
posts.tagline: Open beta: Markdown notes that record calls, no bot
posts.description: Oyma is in open beta and looking for early testers. It's a fast Markdown notes app for Mac with your meetings built in: press record in any note and it captures your mic and the call audio without a bot joining, transcribes on your Mac, and writes the summary and action items into that note. Notes are plain files in a folder you choose; your Obsidian vault opens as is. Local-only mode blocks every network request. Free, no account; Pro adds Oyma AI.

posts.name: Lopaw
posts.tagline: AI trainer for dog separation anxiety, one session a day
posts.description: Lopaw is an AI trainer for dogs that panic when left alone and bark, howl or scratch at the door. It follows the method dog trainers use. You leave for a time your dog can handle and add a little each day. Every day Lopaw tells you what to practice, you report how your dog coped, and it makes the next session harder, the same or easier. A spare phone lets you watch your dog live while you are out. On iPhone, Android, Apple Watch and Wear OS. The first training day is free.

posts.name: Roughs
posts.tagline: Share design work, from early ideas to finished projects
posts.description: Roughs is a place for designers to share what they're making, from early ideas and experiments to finished projects. I started Roughs because I missed the days when we'd just browse, discover great design work, and get inspired by what others were creating. Without ads or distractions getting in the way. We're starting small, but the vision is simple: bring back the joy of sharing and discovering design. Roughs is currently invite-only. Designers can join the waitlist to request access.

posts.name: dsh-market
posts.tagline: Install 12,000+ DeepSeek Harness plugins in one click
posts.description: Browse 12,000+ community plugins for DeepSeek Harness and install in one click; most go live without a restart. Describe what you need and AI search finds it, or let AI guess from the plugins you already use, on your own model. Themes, updates, backup and restore, and a recovery page if a plugin breaks startup. Open source (MIT). Community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

posts.name: Nuwtonic
posts.tagline: The first agentic SEO & AIO platform for Google + AI search
posts.description: Most SEO tools give reports, Nuwtonic gives traffic from Google and AI. Powered by a multi-agent pipeline with 95+ AIO & SEO features, it connects to your brand & Google Search Console to auto-run brand analysis, competitor gaps, AI keyword research & build topical maps trained on Google ranking patents & holistic SEO architecture, generates content at scale. Nuwtonic runs real-time SEO,AIO analysis, audits, auto-fixes, optimizes, applies, publishes, tracks & iterates on all pages & domain.

posts.name: Residency
posts.tagline: Turn photos into travel and tax alerts
posts.description: Digital nomads, expats and frequent travellers all count days: how long they can stay in Schengen, when they turn into tax residents, how close they are to a new passport. Residency does the counting from the photos you already took, so your travel history builds itself, and a boarding-pass scan shows what the next trip changes before you fly. It works offline, and your day counts sit right on the Lock Screen.

posts.name: Fragplace
posts.tagline: Every fragrance. Honest reviews. Your whole collection.
posts.description: Fragplace brings notes, honest reviews and today's best prices for 95,000+ fragrances into one place. Know how a perfume smells before you spend a cent, find similar scents for less, and get a price alert when your bottle drops. Your collection and scent diary remember every bottle you own, want and wear. Free on web, iPhone and Android.

posts.name: ISO 11616 Revision Checker
posts.tagline: The medicinal product ID change, checked
posts.description: The free clause record and scope check for ISO/FDIS 11616, the final draft that replaces ISO 11616:2017. Read all 21 clauses, see the stage timeline, and check whether your product data flow is in scope. The USD 299 kit turns the record into a register with an owner, a due date and an evidence pointer; the USD 29 watch emails the diff when the record changes. No certification, no legal advice, and every page says what is public and what is not.

posts.name: Heya Cards
posts.tagline: Free Apple Wallet cards for your contact links
posts.description: Create Apple Wallet cards for WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, email or each of your phone numbers, or put them all on one universal card. Meet someone new, open Wallet and show your card. They scan the QR code to open your chat or profile, or save your contact details. No digging for your WhatsApp QR code, no spelling your email in a noisy room. Free.

posts.name: Cona
posts.tagline: Photo of a floor plan in, furnished 3D room out
posts.description: Cona turns your space into a 3D room you can furnish, free, in the browser. Upload a photo of a floor plan and AI traces it in about 20 seconds, or scan the room with your phone. Tap Furnish and AI fills it with real furniture from real stores, at real size, with prices and store links. Walk in at eye level, swap anything, or turn a photo of your own chair into 3D. No account to start, no credits, no watermarks.

posts.name: CallCatch AI
posts.tagline: Never miss a lead: AI voice & SMS booking for trade pros
posts.description: CallCatch AI intercepts missed calls with AI-powered instant SMS and voice response for trade contractors, qualifying emergencies and booking jobs 24/7.

posts.name: FrameAmp
posts.tagline: Turn 30 FPS console gameplay into 60 FPS on your Mac.
posts.description: Use your Mac as a gaming monitor for your PS5, Xbox or any HDMI console, through a USB capture card or Remote Play. Frame generation uses Apple's frame interpolation to show GTA 6 and other 30 FPS games at 60 FPS. Apple silicon, macOS Tahoe.

posts.name: Locan
posts.tagline: Your website from real reviews, kept fresh by an AI agent
posts.description: Building a website is the easy part. The hard part is keeping it up to date. Locan builds your business website from the reviews and photos your customers already posted on Google, in about four minutes, with a page for each service and reviews quoted word for word. Then an AI agent keeps it fresh: new reviews, photos and opening hours show up by themselves. It also shows how often ChatGPT names your business. Change anything by chatting with your website. The preview is free, no card.

posts.name: Milo for ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Turn conversations into plans, birthdays, and shared agendas
posts.description: Milo is your friendly agenda, now inside ChatGPT. Instead of manually entering every detail, simply ask ChatGPT to help organize a trip, keep track of birthdays, or plan something with friends and family. Milo brings those plans into an organized agenda you can return to and share. Built by the small team at Tiger Mind Labs, we're exploring a more natural way to turn conversations into real-life plans.

posts.name: EU REX Number Checker
posts.tagline: Check up to 10 EU REX numbers at once, free and open source
posts.description: Importers claim 0% EU duty on a supplier's REX number. Paste up to 10 numbers and see which are valid, the exporter's name, country and registration date, live from the European Commission's database. No login, nothing stored, open source.

posts.name: Nuit Blanche
posts.tagline: Let your agents run with the lid closed.
posts.description: Keeps your MacBook running with the lid shut, on battery, no monitor. Press ⌃⌥⌘L and your Claude Code or Codex agents keep working. They can switch it off when done. A timer, a 20% battery floor and a heat cut-off cover the rest. 5 nights free.

posts.name: Orbit Pro
posts.tagline: See who needs a reply across your Gmail accounts.
posts.description: Pick your Gmail accounts. Orbit puts the emails you need to answer into one list and drafts replies on your Mac. Your mail stays out of cloud AI. In Orbit Chat, you decide when to send each draft. Try it free for 14 days with no card. After that, it’s $19/month.

posts.name: NameKnow Brand Name Score Checker
posts.tagline: Brand Name Spelling Test
posts.description: Free brand and domain name scoring: radio test, mobile fat-finger risk, silent-letter traps, repeated-letter risk, and autocorrect leakage.

posts.name: Prefill
posts.tagline: Autofill for every form on your Mac. No cloud, no AI.
posts.description: Prefill keeps your name, emails, phones, addresses, cards and IDs on your Mac and fills them into any form in one click. Click a field and your details appear right under it, or fill the whole form at once. It remembers answers you type, like your LinkedIn or portfolio, for next time. Cards and IDs need Touch ID. It stays quiet in chats and search bars and steps aside when Safari or Chrome are already suggesting. No account, no cloud, no AI. $15 once.

posts.name: eyeQ
posts.tagline: Challenge your visual perception
posts.description: You think you have a highly accurate visual perception? Are your eyes naturally pixel perfect? Try these tests of proportion, alignment, and geometry and find out whats your eyeQ.

posts.name: JPG Joiner
posts.tagline: Merge JPG Files Into One Image
posts.description: Free online JPG and JPEG merger to combine multiple image files into one. Supports vertical, horizontal, and grid layouts with borders, spacing, and quality control and many other 40+ free image tools

posts.name: PingCRM
posts.tagline: Open-source personal CRM that syncs your DMs and email
posts.description: PingCRM is an open-source personal networking CRM. It syncs Gmail, Telegram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn and WhatsApp into one timeline per contact, scores which relationships are going cold, spots life events like job changes, and drafts follow-ups with AI that it never sends on its own. New since the last launch: WhatsApp sync, an MCP server for Claude and Cursor, duplicate organization merging, and one-click deploys to Railway, Render, DigitalOcean and Fly.io.

posts.name: NameKnow Brand Name Score Checker
posts.tagline: Brand Name Spelling Test
posts.description: Free brand and domain name scoring: radio test, mobile fat-finger risk, silent-letter traps, repeated-letter risk, and autocorrect leakage.

posts.name: eyeQ
posts.tagline: Challenge your visual perception
posts.description: You think you have a highly accurate visual perception? Are your eyes naturally pixel perfect? Try these tests of proportion, alignment, and geometry and find out whats your eyeQ.

posts.name: Nuwtonic
posts.tagline: The first agentic SEO & AIO platform for Google + AI search
posts.description: Most SEO tools give reports, Nuwtonic gives traffic from Google and AI. Powered by a multi-agent pipeline with 95+ AIO & SEO features, it connects to your brand & Google Search Console to auto-run brand analysis, competitor gaps, AI keyword research & build topical maps trained on Google ranking patents & holistic SEO architecture, generates content at scale. Nuwtonic runs real-time SEO,AIO analysis, audits, auto-fixes, optimizes, applies, publishes, tracks & iterates on all pages & domain.

posts.name: BingeNote
posts.tagline: Blank Paper and Stickies
posts.description: BingeNote puts sticky notes where you actually look: your Home Screen, your Lock Screen, your Mac desktop. When you're done, they fall off. STICK IT WHERE YOU'LL SEE IT • Home Screen widgets in three sizes. A single sticky fills the whole widget, like real paper on your screen. • Check things off right from the widget. The app doesn't need to open. • Lock Screen widgets, plus Live Activities and the Dynamic Island for checklists you're working through right now.

posts.name: LocalClock
posts.tagline: World time for people you love
posts.description: LocalClock is a world clock for the place you are standing, and for the people you keep in touch with. Your city stays at the top. The clock, the date, and the sky all follow that place. Drag the line from west to east and the hour moves with you, city by city. Let go, and it springs back to where you are. When the place on screen is not home, the date shows how far ahead or behind that hour is. Solar time sits under the clock.

posts.name: TooBeFun C2
posts.tagline: A Mini Console for Players and Creators
posts.description: Meet TooBeFun C2, a palm-sized mini game console made for quick, casual play. Featuring built-in games, a 1.4-inch full-color display, and a Hall-effect joystick, C2 brings a little fun to the moments in between.

posts.name: GymLedger
posts.tagline: Gym Management Software India
posts.description: Simple gym management app for Indian gyms: track memberships, monthly fees, attendance check-ins and receipts in one private workspace. Start a free 30-day trial.

posts.name: Showthrough - recorder you own
posts.tagline: Loom alternative: pay once, record unlimited videos
posts.description: Press one button and Showthrough handles the rest. It records your screen, camera and voice from any Chrome tab, uploads while you talk, and copies the share link the moment you stop. No limit on how many videos you record or how long they run. Viewers watch in any browser without an account, and can comment at the exact moment. Videos are stored in your own Cloudflare account, which we set up for you in one click. One payment, no subscription. Team members are coming soon at no extra cost.

posts.name: BudgetClick
posts.tagline: Open-source finance planner that only you can read
posts.description: BudgetClick is a free, open-source personal finance tracker and planner that fits on one spreadsheet-style screen, with widgets for the big picture. Everything is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before it leaves it, and synced across your devices through a storage bucket you own. Works offline, installs as a PWA, and needs no account and no subscription. Built in public, with the code, docs and architecture walkthrough all open.

posts.name: ThetaSign
posts.tagline: Android PDF Digital Signing with USB DSC Tokens
posts.description: ThetaSign enables professionals to digitally sign PDF documents on Android using USB Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) tokens. Secure, mobile and trusted PDF signing by SSPL.

posts.name: Motchi
posts.tagline: a calm notch for your Windows screen
posts.description: Motchi turns the top of your Windows screen into a calm little notch: tasks, gentle reminders, a focus timer, water and mood, with a soft mascot. Free forever. Made for brains that wander.

posts.name: Vaiyah
posts.tagline: AI Studio for images, video & audio, with tree planting
posts.description: Generate images, video and audio with your choice of AI models. Edit your work with a free video editor and image tools, and build your brand with logos and style guides. No subscription. Pay as you go. Sign up for 20 free Nano Banana images and one free Veo video every day for a limited time. Add an optional contribution to help fund tree planting through Ecologi.

posts.name: BeChosenBy
posts.tagline: See if ChatGPT recommends your business, and how to fix it
posts.description: BeChosenBy asks ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity 10 questions your buyers ask in your category. The report shows how often each engine names you, which businesses it names instead, which websites it cites, and five fixes ranked by impact. The Fix Pack writes those fixes for you: homepage lines, a comparison page, an FAQ with structured data and outreach emails. Free preview with one real buyer question; one-time reports from $19, no subscription.

posts.name: pomo pact
posts.tagline: Can't Focus? Create a Pact with Friends and Focus Together
posts.description: A shared pomodoro board for you and your friends. No accounts. Just a name and a timer.

posts.name: IngrediScan AI
posts.tagline: Scan food labels to spot allergens, additives & E-numbers
posts.description: IngrediScan AI decodes food, beverage, and cosmetic labels in seconds using advanced AI. Simply snap a photo of any ingredient list to instantly uncover hidden additives, E-numbers, and potential health risks. Tailor your scan results to your personal health and dietary needs—including vegan, diabetic, pregnancy-safe, and common allergens. Keep your family's pantry safe with instant health scores, clarity checks, and a complete additive dictionary.

posts.name: Echo Lantern
posts.tagline: Echo Lantern
posts.description: Want to Play Echo Lantern? 🕹️ On GamePix You Can Play Echo Lantern for Free. Start Playing Now!

posts.name: TestFi
posts.tagline: Real people test your app and talk you through it
posts.description: Real people use your app on their own phones, record the screen and say out loud where they get stuck. Pay per tester: $3.99 written, $5.99 recorded, no subscription. Android devs: $39.99 covers Google Play's 12-tester, 14-day closed test.

posts.name: BiVelio Savings Layer
posts.tagline: Cut LLM costs with an open-source savings layer
posts.description: BiVelio Savings helps developers reduce LLM API costs with caching, request deduplication and prompt optimization. Run the open-source engine on your own infrastructure and inspect a savings report for each request, with measured and estimated savings clearly separated. Add an optional cloud dashboard for your team. Your prompts never pass through BiVelio's servers.

posts.name: KeyTally
posts.tagline: Property management software with an AI that does the books
posts.description: AI property management software for landlords, property managers and HOAs. Rent, leases, late fees, expenses, owner statements, trust accounting and HOA dues in one place. Tell Ask KeyTally what happened and it does the entry; you confirm. Free for 60 days, no card needed.

posts.name: Askesis
posts.tagline: A finish line for your next challenge
posts.description: Askesis is a challenge tracker for iPhone. Pick one commitment, define a daily action and set a finish date. Keep a record of your progress, then decide what to repeat or change. Designed for focused experiments rather than an indefinite promise to change everything at once.

posts.name: Askesis
posts.tagline: A finish line for your next challenge
posts.description: Askesis is a challenge tracker for iPhone. Pick one commitment, define a daily action and set a finish date. Keep a record of your progress, then decide what to repeat or change. Designed for focused experiments rather than an indefinite promise to change everything at once.

posts.name: Pinchery
posts.tagline: Cook the recipes you keep saving
posts.description: Pinchery turns TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and recipe website links into ingredients and steps, with credit to the creator. Change portions, get ingredient swaps for your country and cook from a clear recipe. Works in your browser on any phone or computer.

posts.name: Lernelle
posts.tagline: AI tutor that turns any goal into a structured course
posts.description: Tell Lernelle what you want to learn and get a plan at your level: short lessons, quizzes that bring back what you missed, and a tutor that knows where you are. Coding runs in the browser. Free to start.

posts.name: DualZen
posts.tagline: Record Portrait and Landscape Video at the Same Time
posts.description: DualZen is a phone camera that records 9:16 portrait and 16:9 landscape video or photos from one take, with a built-in teleprompter, pro controls, and front + back camera capture, for iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Bridely
posts.tagline: Wedding invitations on WhatsApp, RSVPs that plan for you
posts.description: Bridely connects the three sides of a wedding: couples, planners and vendors. Couples send invitations on WhatsApp; replies fill the guest list, seating and budget. Planners run every client wedding in one place. Vendors get a free page and direct enquiries.

posts.name: TicketRadar
posts.tagline: Movie Ticket Alerts, Get Notified When Bookings Open
posts.description: Set movie ticket alerts for your chosen movie, date and cinemas and get notified the moment tickets become available.

posts.name: Launchpat
posts.tagline: Go where your users are. Show up with the right reply.
posts.description: Launchpat learns your game, app or SaaS, then finds people looking for something like it on Reddit and Bluesky (X, Hacker News, YouTube, and Steam and App Store reviews on paid plans) and drafts the reply in your voice. It plans your launch and watches competitors. You approve everything.

posts.name: zones.fyi
posts.tagline: A time zone converter that works well on phones
posts.description: For anyone who checks other cities' times on their phone. Add your cities, drag one bar to change the time, and every city updates. Pick a 30 min, 1 hr or 2 hr slot and it flags anyone who'd be asleep or outside work hours, then copy all the times into a message. No signup, no ads.

posts.name: BandBloom
posts.tagline: IELTS & CELPIP practice with progress tracking
posts.description: BandBloom is a free language exam preparation platform for IELTS and CELPIP learners. Practise reading, listening, writing and speaking, complete timed exercises, create study plans and monitor your progress in one place. Built for students and prospective immigrants who want accessible, structured exam preparation. BandBloom is currently in early access, and we're looking for learners to test the experience and help shape future features.

posts.name: ChefAlong
posts.tagline: Free Recipe Calculators & Kitchen Tools
posts.description: Make everyday kitchen calculations easier. Calculate ingredient costs, convert measurements, resize recipes and estimate nutrition with four free tools. For home cooks, bakers, cloud-kitchen owners, chefs, restauranters, fitness enthusiasts and foodies. Understand your food cost, recipe weight, recipe adjustments and general estimation of nutritional metrics for everyday use. Full free access available. Try three calculations daily without an account, or sign up for unlimited free use.

posts.name: Synthetic Consumer Research
posts.tagline: Test product ideas on AI customers before you build
posts.description: AI rates every product idea 3 or 4 out of 5. This open-source agent skill uses Semantic Similarity Rating (arXiv 2510.08338): AI personas answer in words, scored by meaning into realistic ratings. Get purchase intent, segments and objections.

posts.name: Price Right
posts.tagline: Shared grocery list comparing live unit prices. Zero ads.
posts.description: Price Right is a free, ad-free shared grocery list for iOS and Android that compares real per-unit prices ($/oz, €/kg, Kč/l) across nearby supermarkets and online stores so you stop guessing whether the bulk pack or another store is cheaper. Snap shelf tags or receipts with your camera, group items by store aisle, and share live checklists via a web link with no app install required. Built for 15 countries and 10 languages, plus a free web unit-price calculator.

posts.name: AIR Office
posts.tagline: Your personal AI safety lab in an app.
posts.description: Keep AI safety research, evaluations, and policy work private and structured in one local-first desktop lab. AIR Office combines grounded knowledge management, guardrails, and shareable agent workflows in a free, open-source app for Windows and macOS.

posts.name: Kaer AI
posts.tagline: The AI agent that does the work in every tool you log into
posts.description: AI agents that do the work in every tool you log into, in one shared workspace: they work the inbox, run scheduled workflows, operate web apps in a sandboxed browser (portals with no integration included) and build the missing tool, with consequential actions held for your approval.

posts.name: Aonin
posts.tagline: Stream audio from multiple computers to one listener
posts.description: Choose the computer connected to your headphones or speakers as the listener. Aonin finds other computers on your local network and streams their system or mic audio to one output. Silence sender speakers without extra audio drivers, adjust each device's volume, mute streams, and monitor levels. Supports up to 24-bit/48 kHz, with lighter options for weak Wi-Fi. Free on Windows and macOS. Pro adds private sessions with join codes and quick listener switching without reconnecting devices.

posts.name: TimerHaven
posts.tagline: Minimalist, ad-free focus and interval timer for iOS & Web
posts.description: Most timer apps have become bloated subscription machines demanding $5–$10/month just to run a Pomodoro clock, popping up video ads during deep work, or locking interval settings behind paywalls. I built TimerHaven to be the exact opposite: clean, fast, completely free of intrusive ads, and private by design. v1.1.3 brings the suite to iOS with rock-solid background alerts that fire even when your phone locks, customizable work/rest cycles, stopwatch with laps, and no sign-up required.

posts.name: Kreators Clan
posts.tagline: Creators send it. Brands ask for it.
posts.description: Brands ask for "insights", creators send 12 screenshots, and nobody trusts the numbers. Kreators Clan fixes this with the Clan Card: a media kit in one link, read straight from Instagram. Best posts, followers, reach per post, strengths and audience cities, with nothing editable by hand. Creators choose what it shows, see how often it's opened and can switch it off. Free for nano and micro creators, with a weekly Insights coach and paid brand jobs built in.

posts.name: splash
posts.tagline: find movies from a clip or your camera
posts.description: saw a scene but nobody named the movie? splash helps you find it. point your camera at a screen or upload a clip, watch the dialogue appear, and get a movie match with artwork and viewing search links. save discoveries for later. works in your browser with no account needed. free beta with daily usage limits.

posts.name: MUT Inspector
posts.tagline: Check BOMs, STEP models and technical docs before production
posts.description: Catch errors before production. MUT Inspector cross-checks BOMs, STEP models and PDFs using your company rules. Review highlighted issues and export a custom BOM. Runs offline on Windows, keeping original files unchanged. Free 14-day trial.

posts.name: Retail Sales Data Cleaner
posts.tagline: Instant ETL CSV cleaner with 30s auto-purge & analytics
posts.description: Drop messy retail sales CSVs and get cleaned, profiled, and sanitized data in seconds. Built with FastAPI, Pandas, Neon PostgreSQL, and Next.js—featuring zero-signup Guest Mode (with automatic 30-second database TTL purge), idempotent cloud upserts, and Excel formula-injection protection.
